name: Augment Code
tagline: Augment Code is an AI software development tool that integrates into IDEs like VS Code and JetBrains to provide context-aware code completions, chat, and edits. It indexes the entire codebase to deliver suggestions that are aware of existing patterns, APIs, and conventions.
